passage.text_en:
UPDATED BORROWING POLICY — Effective July 1st

Book Loans:
• Fiction: 3 weeks (renewable once)
• Non-fiction: 4 weeks (renewable twice)
• New releases: 2 weeks (non-renewable)
Late fees: $0.25 per day per item (maximum $5.00 per item).

Digital Resources:
• E-books and audiobooks: 21-day automatic return
• No late fees on digital items

You can now place holds on up to 15 items (previously 10). Items not picked up within 5 days will be released to the next person on the waitlist.

Scan your library card at our new self-checkout stations!
